discovery_screen: carry only if n>=100, mean excess >= +0.50%, calendar-month t >= z(1-0.05/5) = 2.33.
holdout_confirmation: EDGE only if calendar-month t >= z(1 - 0.05/M), M = hypotheses carried to a holdout across ALL rounds; mean excess > 0 at 0.10% and 0.30% cost; n >= 50.
